snippet.title: Wiseman - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wiseman: No More Breakups is OUT NOW on PC.

Get it: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4664920/Wiseman_No_More_Breakups/

Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back. 

She took his phone. He just wants it back. The train has other plans.

This is not a rhythm game about dancing. This is a rhythm game about surviving a relationship.

Developer: Gilang Gumelar Studios
X: https://x.com/ggsmmxix
